title: Spotify Ads: Reach Millions of Music Lovers | Be My Social

facts.fact: The page states that Spotify has over 345 million monthly active users.
facts.quote: With over 345 million monthly active users, Spotify has become one of the most popular music streaming platforms in the world.

facts.fact: The page states that Spotify's ad platform uses a cost-per-mille model, under which advertisers pay for every 1,000 impressions.
facts.quote: Spotify’s ad platform is a cost-per-mille model, meaning that advertisers pay for every 1,000 impressions.

facts.fact: The page says Spotify's ad platform has been criticised as quite expensive for small businesses, without giving a price or budget figure.
facts.quote: Spotify’s ad platform has been criticised for being quite expensive for small businesses

facts.fact: The page lists sponsored sessions and sponsored playlists as Spotify ad formats.
facts.quote: These include sponsored sessions, where businesses can sponsor a user’s listening session, and sponsored playlists, where businesses can sponsor a playlist that will be featured to a targeted audience.
